<thought>From the 13C NMR data, carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm) are at 24.56, 19.40, and 16.60 ppm. Additionally, a signal at 57.20 ppm corresponds to a methoxy (O‑CH₃) carbon, which is also a methyl carbon. Therefore the molecule contains four distinct CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
